npm.description: A development flow that separates what is wanted from how it gets built — requirements accumulate in a sibling directory outside the code repository, a batch of them becomes one release, and each step is gated on something measurable rather than on a report that says it went fine.

interface.longDescription: Keeps requirements out of the code repository entirely — they live in a sibling directory, one file per item, with the state written in the file itself rather than in a shared list that two sessions can clobber. A batch of them becomes one release with one version bump, which is the unit that a per-change flow keeps getting wrong. Every step is gated on something that can be re-run and measured, because a step that only reports its own success is a step with no gate at all.
